pick.title: Choose a Profiler
pick.description: These Profilers answered on the local network.

manual.title: Connect to a Profiler
manual.description: Enter the address of the Profiler. Its network port is on the device under System > Network.

data_description.host: The Profiler's IP address or host name.
data_description.port: Leave this at 5727 unless the Profiler was told to use another port.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open a session with that Profiler. Check the address, and that the Profiler is switched on and on the network.

init.title: Activity detection
init.description: How the Profiler decides that someone is playing. The output level is read from the rig output meter, after the rig volume and before the master volume.

data_description.activity_window: How long the output has to stay below the threshold before activity turns off.
data_description.activity_threshold: How loud the rig output has to be to count as playing, as a percentage of full scale.
